text: 1. this policy sets the core rules for company spending and money management. 2. all staff must follow these rules when they use company funds. 3. the finance team must check and approve all budgets before spending starts. 4. workers must get approval from a boss before they buy items for work. 5. you must keep every receipt for any business cost you pay. 6. submit your money back forms within thirty days of the cost date. 7. the firm does not pay back money for personal items or food. 8. travel
